note: Personal sponsors (track-viewer/docs/career-mode.md section 13): brands from assets/sponsors/manifest.json, split by tier. retainer is U per round, bonus is that many rounds of retainer on hitting the target. Slots = the tier's rank. Starting values, not measurements.

jio.name: Jio
jio.pitch: They back young drivers on the way up. Keep the car on the road and they stay happy.

oppo.name: OPPO
oppo.pitch: They want you near the front in every highlight reel.

vivo.name: vivo
vivo.pitch: They like a driver who beats the car next to them on the clock.

rayban.name: Ray-Ban
rayban.pitch: Style counts, but a good grid slot photographs better.

cocacola.name: Coca-Cola
cocacola.pitch: Everyone watches the podium. They want you standing on it.

pirelli.name: Pirelli
pirelli.pitch: Tyres win qualifying. Prove it for them.

sony.name: Sony
sony.pitch: A clean race makes good television.

shell.name: Shell
shell.pitch: They want results they can put on a forecourt.

redbull.name: Red Bull
redbull.pitch: Win. That is the whole brief.

emirates.name: Emirates
emirates.pitch: A season at the sharp end, on every broadcast.

rolex.name: Rolex
rolex.pitch: They put their name on the clock. Beat it.

hsbc.name: HSBC
hsbc.pitch: Steady returns. A clean season suits them best.
